thread.title: Shares of Apple, iPhone suppliers extend losses after WSJ report of further production cuts

author: Emily Bary
title: Shares of Apple, iPhone suppliers extend losses after WSJ report of further production cuts
text: Shares of Apple Inc. AAPL, -3.49% and several of its iPhone suppliers are down in Monday morning trading, extending their losses from the prior week. Apple shares are off 2.7% in the session, while shares of Lumentum Holdings Inc. LITE, -4.36% which makes sensors for the iPhone's facial recognition feature, are down 4.3%. Semiconductor company Qorvo Inc. QRVO, -3.88% has seen its shares drop 0.8% Monday morning, while shares of Skyworks Solutions Inc. SWKS, -2.28% are down 1.6%. The Wall Street Journal reported Monday that Apple made a second round of iPhone XR production cuts "in the past week," following an earlier batch of cuts in late October. The company didn't immediately respond to a MarketWatch request for comment. Late on Sunday, Cowen & Co. analyst Karl Ackerman warned that iPhone production cuts "compound an already weak supply/demand backdrop for memory producers in CQ4:18 and CQ1:19 and should be deflationary to memory [average selling prices]." He expects a 10-cent earnings impact for Micron Technology Inc. MU, -5.81% and a 15-cent impact for Western Digital Corp. WDC, -1.93% spread across the December and March quarters. Apple shares have gained 11% over the past 12 months, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -1.32% has gained 8.3%.
